visualCharacteristics.purpose: Client-side BMI calculator with metric/imperial toggle, height and weight inputs, BMI result and health-risk category; nothing is submitted
visualCharacteristics.layout: heading and unit toggle in a header row, two input fields side by side from 600px, submit button aligned right, result below

contentPattern.structure: key/value rows. Title | heading text (or a heading row); Metric | label; Imperial | label; Units label | optional legend; Height | label; Weight | label; Metric units | "cm, kg"; Imperial units | "ft, in, st, lb"; Button | button label; Result | result prefix e.g. "Your BMI is"; Error | message when inputs are missing; Category | category name | upper BMI limit (exclusive, empty for the last one) | optional description. Any other single-cell row is shown as intro text
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Interactive BMI calculator: heading "Find your BMI and health risks", metric/imperial toggle, height (cm) and weight (kg) inputs, submit button

usage: Home page BMI section directly under the hero.
reuseGuidance: All labels, units and categories are authored, so the block can be localised per market without code changes.
